Markets.summary: Unlisted shares of the Calcutta Stock Exchange have more than doubled over three months due to growing revival hopes. The exchange plans to pause its voluntary exit process to explore opportunities across multiple financial segments, pending regulatory approval and anchor investors.

Markets.summary: Fosun Pharma plans to sell a 5% stake in Gland Pharma through a block deal worth Rs 2,279.5 crore at Rs 2,763 per share. This divestment follows Gland Pharma's reported 47% increase in Q1FY27 profit.

Markets.title: Tyson Foods cuts annual profit forecast again as beef pressure drains margins
Markets.summary: Tyson Foods has lowered its fiscal 2026 profit and sales forecasts for the second time due to margin pressure in its beef segment. To address these industry challenges, the company plans to sell or close three of its beef plants.

Markets.title: Campbell's forecasts weak year ahead on pressured consumer spending
Markets.summary: Campbell's cut its quarterly dividend to focus on debt reduction and forecast a weak year ahead after fourth-quarter revenue fell more than expected. The company is responding to lower-income consumers shifting to more affordable brands by revising prices across its product line.

Geo-Political.summary: A toxic wildfire haze driven by an intensifying El Niño has spread across Southeast Asia, exposing millions of people to dangerous smog. Over 12,000 children have suffered respiratory issues as a result of the poor air quality.

Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation reveals that a shortage of small boats is forcing once-rival Channel smuggling gangs to collaborate. Consequently, these criminal groups have begun using larger "mega-dinghies" to transport migrants.

Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan stated he has neither questioned nor endorsed India's official GDP figures. He expressed confusion over how the reported economic growth is occurring without a corresponding rise in private investment, foreign direct investment, or jobs.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal calls for nationwide push to unlock export benefits under FTAs
